description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003. Order under Section 18, Order No. 12
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 18 of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It excludes specific goods (Milk Powder, LPG, Wheat Flour, Cement) from the "Specified Goods" list that were previously prescribed through other gazette notifications. This constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
